sn35.152:1.1: sace vo bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:
sn35.152:1.3: evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ vyākareyyātha:
sn35.152:1.4: dukkhassa kho āvuso pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
sn35.152:1.5: sace pana vo bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ:
sn35.152:1.6: katamaṃ pana taṃ āvuso dukkhaṃ yassa pariññāya samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti?
sn35.152:1.7: evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ vyākareyyātha:
sn35.152:2.9: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tampi dukkhaṃ,
sn35.152:2.10: tassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati. sotaṃ dukkhaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ dukkhaṃ …pe…
sn35.152:2.14: yampidaṃ manosamphassa paccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ,
sn35.152:2.18: evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ vyākareyyāthāti.
